version.labels: L3 2026-11-08 owner closing pass: acceptability (atmosphere picture at overview, Roman Empire picture at deep, precision-recall curve everywhere) and Core/Optional sketches | L4 2026-11-09 owner relabel (token-links accepted for attention-weights)

measures: Does the author write correct diagram JSON at each depth (overview: plain-word labels, no formulas, simplest kind; standard: the mechanism with its terms; deep: the formula or exact relationship in labels, a plot or chart when a quantity is involved, maths in $...$). Run with --depths overview,standard,deep.
written: 2026-11-08, before any correct-svg card was sent
notation: Per depth: kinds = right diagram kinds (a picture or a second diagram beside it is allowed), acceptableKinds = weaker kinds; sketch = what the nodes, axes and edges must say. best/acceptable mixes are derived from these per depth. Sketch lines: "Core:" = the elements the diagram must have; "Optional:" = extras a short card may leave out.

Optional: The sun as what drives it.
Core: Evaporation -> condensation -> precipitation -> collection, looping back to evaporation.
Optional: The sun's heat driving evaporation; runoff and groundwater.

Optional: Energy terms (solar energy, latent heat); storage reservoirs.

prompts.prompt: When someone says entropy, what are they talking about?

sketch: Core: Entropy connected to disorder or spreading out: more ways to arrange things means more entropy.
Optional: An everyday example (ice melting, a shuffled deck).
Core: Entropy linked to the number of possible arrangements (microstates) and to disorder; an isolated system's entropy does not decrease.
Optional: A before/after example; energy spreading out.
Core: Entropy linked to the number of microstates W (S = k_B ln W) and to the second law.
Optional: Delta S = Q / T; values of W; a chart of entropy against W.

prompts.prompt: What's meant by Gini impurity?

sketch: Core: A pure node (one class) next to a mixed node, the mixed one more impure.
Optional: Counts per class.
Core: A node's class shares (bars or counts), the purer node having the lower impurity.
Optional: A split into purer children.
Core: Gini = 1 - sum of squared class shares, as the curve 2p(1-p) over p or as bars with the value computed.
Optional: Worked numbers (3 A / 1 B gives 0.375); the peak 0.5 at p = 0.5.

prompts.prompt: What's the idea behind cross-entropy?

sketch: Core: The true answer next to the model's guess; a confident wrong guess costs more than a confident right one.
Optional: Example probabilities.
Core: The predicted probability of the true class against the loss: a low probability gives a high loss.
Optional: The one-hot true distribution next to the predictions.
Core: The loss -ln(p) of the true class's probability (or -sum p log q): large near 0, 0 at p = 1.
Optional: Worked values; a second curve for the other class.
